title: Gevrey instability in the inviscid inflow-outflow problem
summary: We consider the 2D incompressible Euler equations on a periodic channel $\mathbb{T}\times (0,1)$ with inflow-outflow boundary condition $u=(0,1)$ on $\mathbb{T} \times \{0,1 \}$. We also impose the incoming vorticity boundary condition $ω=η$ on $\mathbb{T}\times \{ 0 \}$, where $η$ is prescribed. We show that the problem is globally well-posed in Gevrey spaces (for any value of the Gevrey exponent $s>1$) as long as $η$ remains Gevrey.
